description: Full-width hero section with headline, optional subheading, optional CTA buttons (primary + secondary), and optional image. Supports four structural layouts.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color (e.g. one word or phrase). Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored and title renders normally.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title (e.g. "NEW", "PLUGIN OFICIAL").

subheading.description: Supporting subheadline shown below the title.

button_text.description: Primary CTA button label. Leave empty to hide both buttons.

button_url.description: Primary CTA button URL. Accepts an absolute URL, a site-relative /path, an #anchor, mailto:, or tel:; a disallowed protocol (javascript:, data:) is rejected at write time.

button2_text.description: Secondary CTA button label. Renders as outline/ghost style. Only shown when button_text is also set.

button2_url.description: Secondary CTA button URL. Accepts an absolute URL, a site-relative /path, an #anchor, mailto:, or tel:; a disallowed protocol (javascript:, data:) is rejected at write time.

button_variant.description: Primary button style. 'primary' = filled accent (bare .btn). 'secondary' = muted surface fill. 'outline' = accent border, transparent fill. 'ghost' = borderless text button. Set via update_component (a prop, not a style slot).

button2_variant.description: Second button style — defaults to 'outline' so a primary + secondary pair reads as one filled action and one outlined action. 'primary' = filled accent. 'secondary' = muted surface fill. 'outline' = accent border, transparent fill. 'ghost' = borderless text button. Set via update_component (a prop, not a style slot). Only rendered when button2_text is set.

layout.description: Structural layout. 'centered' centers all content. 'left' aligns content left. 'split' places text left and image right at lg+; if a 'split' hero has neither an image (image_url/image_id) nor proof, there is nothing for the second column, so it degrades to the single-column 'left' layout (text at full content width) — add an image or proof to get the two-column split. 'cover' uses image_url as a full-width background image with dark overlay and white text. (Color/tone is controlled by style slots, not this prop.)

image_url.description: Image URL. Rendered as an inline image in the 'split' layout, or as a CSS background-image in the 'cover' layout.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the split-layout image. Use a descriptive string for meaningful images; leave empty only if image is purely decorative.

image_id.description: Media Library attachment ID for the split-layout image (NOT a URL). When it resolves to a real attachment, the image renders responsively with srcset/sizes via wp_get_attachment_image() instead of a single fixed-size . Falls back to image_url when unset or unresolvable. Get an attachment id via the import_media apply.

spacing.description: Vertical padding override. 'compact' tightens padding. 'spacious' adds extra breathing room. 'default' uses the component's built-in padding (subject to CSS rhythm defaults).

width.description: Content width override. 'narrow' constrains to 56rem. 'full' stretches to viewport (with padding). 'default' uses the standard max-width.

split_ratio.description: Grid column ratio for the split layout. '60-40' gives more space to text, '40-60' gives more to the image. Ignored on non-split layouts.

vertical_align.description: Vertical alignment of content within the hero. Applies to cover and split layouts only. Ignored on centered/left layouts. Ignored below 1024px. 'stretch' is for the split layout: the media column fills the content column's height (equal-height columns) and the image sizes to that box with object-fit: cover, so one asset balances any headline length instead of a fixed-aspect card that dwarfs a tall headline. On the cover layout 'stretch' renders like 'center'.

proof.description: HTML string for trust signals (client logos, star ratings, user counts). Rendered after the CTA group inside hero__content. Sanitized via wp_kses_post. When empty, no DOM element is rendered.

--hero-padding-top.description: Top padding of the hero section

--hero-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the hero section

--hero-bg.description: Background color or gradient. Note: also used as the outline button's hover text color, which is invalid CSS if set to a gradient — that hover color falls back to inherited text color when this is a gradient (a narrow, isolated cosmetic limitation, not a broken page).

--hero-heading-color.description: Hero title text color. It ALSO drives the outline/ghost button ink and ring inside the hero — a residue of this slot's pre-rename band-ink role (#576) that the name does not describe. The subheading is NOT one of its jobs; that is --hero-subheading-color.

--hero-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the title, if set

--hero-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--hero-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --hero-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--hero-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --hero-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--hero-eyebrow-text-transform.description: Eyebrow pill letter-casing. Default uppercase renders the kicker in caps; set none to keep it as authored (e.g. sentence case), or lowercase / capitalize.

--hero-accent.description: Primary button BORDER color (and the outline CTA's hover fill). Does NOT recolor the filled primary button's visible gradient fill on its own — set --hero-button-bg for that (the filled primary ships a premium gradient the accent border sits around).

--hero-accent-hover.description: Primary button hover BORDER color (and the outline CTA's hover fill), mirroring --hero-accent at rest. Does NOT recolor the filled primary button's visible hover fill on its own — set --hero-button-hover-bg for that (the filled primary ships a premium hover gradient the accent border sits around). It also outranks --hero-button2-hover-bg on the SECOND CTA, so setting it keeps that button's hover ring on the accent even when its hover fill is recolored (#538).

--hero-button-bg.description: Primary (filled) button RESTING fill color, independent of --hero-accent (which only recolors the border). Set a flat color to replace the premium gradient with a solid brand fill; pair with --hero-accent (border) and optionally --hero-button-color (ink) for a fully brand-colored filled hero CTA. Unset, the button keeps the premium gradient. This slot governs the RESTING state only — set --hero-button-hover-bg for the hover fill, otherwise hover keeps the premium gradient. Applies to the PRIMARY button only — it never reaches the second CTA, which has its own --hero-button2-* slots.

--hero-button-hover-bg.description: Primary (filled) button HOVER fill color. Set a flat color to replace the premium hover gradient with a solid brand fill, the way --hero-button-bg does for the resting state; pair the two for a filled hero CTA that stays on-brand through the hover. Unset, hover keeps the premium gradient. Set it TOGETHER with --hero-button-bg when the button should already look branded at rest; with only the hover slot set the resting button keeps the premium gradient and the brand fill appears on hover. Either way the swap is clean: on a PRIMARY button the fill and its ring change instantly instead of animating, so no unchosen in-between color renders; the outline/ghost/secondary variants keep the shared button cross-fade. When --hero-accent-hover is also unset, the hover border FOLLOWS this fill so a fill-only recolor keeps a matching ring. Applies to the PRIMARY button only — it never reaches the second CTA, which has --hero-button2-hover-bg.

--hero-button-color.description: Primary (filled) button text (ink) color, independent of --hero-accent. Reverts to the default light ink on hover. Applies to the PRIMARY button only — it never reaches the second CTA, which has --hero-button2-color.

--hero-button-shadow.description: Primary (filled) button box shadow. Set to `none` for a FLAT button (removes the gradient bevel/drop shadow on rest AND hover); pair with --hero-button-bg (a flat color) and --hero-button-color (ink) for a flat primary hero CTA. Applies to the PRIMARY button only — it never reaches the second CTA (which has no elevation slot: a filled second button keeps the premium bevel).

--hero-button2-bg.description: Second CTA button RESTING background color, independent of the primary button (the --hero-button2-* slots are never affected by --hero-button-*, in rest or hover). Applies whatever button2_variant is set to: on a filled (primary) second button it replaces the premium gradient with a flat fill, exactly as --hero-button-bg does for the primary button. This slot governs the RESTING state only — set --hero-button2-hover-bg for the hover fill, otherwise hover keeps the premium gradient.

--hero-button2-border.description: Second CTA button border color, independent of the primary button. Leave unset and the border FOLLOWS --hero-button2-bg (after --hero-accent), so a fill-only recolor keeps a matching ring; set this only when the ring should differ from the fill.

--hero-button2-color.description: Second CTA button text color, independent of the primary button.

--hero-button2-hover-bg.description: Second CTA button hover background color, independent of the primary button's --hero-button-hover-bg. Applies whatever button2_variant is set to: on a filled (primary) second button it replaces the premium hover gradient with a flat fill, exactly as --hero-button-hover-bg does for the primary button. Pair with --hero-button2-bg for a second CTA that stays on-brand through the hover. On a PRIMARY button the fill and its ring change instantly rather than animating, so no unchosen in-between color renders; the outline/ghost/secondary variants keep the shared button cross-fade.

--hero-button2-hover-border.description: Second CTA button hover border color. Unset, it falls to --hero-accent-hover, then to --hero-button2-hover-bg, then to the theme default — so on a FILLED second button a recolored hover fill already carries a matching ring with no border slot set, mirroring --hero-button2-border at rest. Set this (or --hero-accent-hover) only when the hover ring should DIFFER from the hover fill. The outline/ghost/secondary variants do not follow the hover fill: on those, set this slot explicitly for a ring that tracks a recolored hover fill.

--hero-button2-hover-color.description: Second CTA button hover text color.

--hero-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the hero TITLE. Default "none" (uncapped) on every layout. Hero is deliberately EXEMPT from the shared --measure-heading token, the same exemption it already has from the shared heading scale: .hero__content is a flex item that shrink-wraps to its WIDEST child, so a cap here narrows the whole content column (title, subheading AND buttons), not just the H1 — and a ch value is viewport-local while the column is not, so any value tight enough to shape the headline also strands the column at laptop widths. The hero measure you almost always want is --hero-content-width. Set this only to deliberately hold the headline narrower than the column; "none" restores the default.

--hero-proof-color.description: Proof line text color (trust signals below the CTA); route it to a light value on dark heroes so it is not dark-on-dark

--hero-content-width.description: Maximum width of the hero CONTENT COLUMN — eyebrow, title, subheading, buttons and proof together. This is hero's real measure. The default varies by layout and viewport and is NOT one value: below 768px it is uncapped (the viewport binds); on centered/left/cover at 768px and up it is var(--measure-centered) (56rem); on split at 1024px and up it is 40rem, and the grid track usually binds before that cap does. Setting this slot replaces ALL of those branches with the single value you write, at every layout and viewport — so pick a value that works at 375 as well as 1440.

--hero-overlay-bg.description: Cover-layout overlay background color or gradient (e.g. a transparent-to-dark scrim for text legibility over an image)

--hero-image-position.description: Split-layout image focal point (object-position) — where the image crops from when its aspect ratio doesn't match --hero-image-aspect-ratio

--hero-image-aspect-ratio.description: Split-layout image aspect ratio (e.g. '16/9', '1'). Default 'auto' preserves the image's natural proportions

--hero-border-color.description: Border color of the hero section

--hero-border-width.description: Border width of the hero section

--hero-radius.description: Border radius of the hero section

--hero-shadow.description: Box shadow of the hero section (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

--hero-surface-bg.description: Background of the inner proof/artifact surface panel — a solid color or a gradient (the default is itself a gradient; set either to override it)

--hero-surface-padding.description: Padding inside the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-border-color.description: Border color of the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-border-width.description: Border width of the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-radius.description: Border radius of the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-shadow.description: Box shadow of the inner hero surface panel (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

dark-spacious.description: Dark background with generous padding and light text

bold-headline.description: Oversized title with narrow content column
